cards.text: Jesus has just said that some of those standing there will see the kingdom of God come with power. Six days later, He takes three of His disciples up a high mountain, just them and nobody else.

cards.question: Jesus leads three of His disciples up a high mountain by themselves. Which three?

cards.text: Up there, right in front of them, Jesus is transfigured. His clothes change, brighter than any launderer on earth could bleach them.

cards.question: On the mountain, Jesus' clothes change. They become radiantly ___.

cards.text: Friend, I've worn a white apron my whole baking life, and I have NEVER gotten it that white. Then two more people appear on that mountain, talking with Jesus.

cards.question: Two men appear on the high mountain and talk with Jesus. Who are they?

cards.text: Elijah the prophet and Moses, Israel's leader, right there with Jesus. Peter speaks up and tells Jesus it is good for them to be here, and he offers to put up three shelters.

cards.question: Peter offers to put up three shelters on the mountain. Who are the three shelters for?
Peter offers to put up a shelter for Jesus, one for Moses and one for Elijah. Why does Peter say this?

answers.text: They were so terrified he didn't know what else to say
Jesus had asked him to build shelters for all three of them
He wanted all Israel to remember the place where it happened

cards.text: Friend, I get it: when I'm scared, my mouth starts meetings my brain NEVER approved. Then a cloud appears and wraps around them, and a voice comes from the cloud.

cards.question: The voice from the cloud says, "This is My beloved Son. Listen to Him!" Who is the voice talking about?
After the voice speaks, the disciples suddenly look around. Moses and Elijah are still standing there with Jesus.

cards.text: Now it's just Jesus with Peter, James and John, heading back down the mountain. On the way, Jesus gives them firm instructions about what they've seen.

cards.question: Coming down the mountain, what does Jesus tell the three disciples to do about what they saw?

answers.text: Tell no one until the Son of Man has risen from the dead
Tell the other disciples as soon as they get back down
Tell the crowds in every village they pass through

cards.question: The three disciples keep the matter to themselves. What do they discuss among themselves?

answers.text: What it meant to rise from the dead
Which one of them was the greatest
Where Moses and Elijah had gone

cards.text: Imagine seeing THAT and keeping it out of every group chat you're in. Then they bring Jesus a question about something the scribes, Israel's teachers of the law, say about Elijah.

cards.question: The disciples ask Jesus about the scribes' teaching. What do the scribes say about Elijah?

cards.text: Jesus says Elijah does indeed come first, and he restores all things. Then Jesus asks a question right back, about what is written of the Son of Man.

cards.question: Jesus asks His disciples a question about the Son of Man. What does Jesus say is written about Him?

answers.text: He must suffer many things and be rejected
He must be welcomed by every leader
He must stay hidden from every crowd

cards.question: Jesus tells Peter, James and John that Elijah has already come, and people did to him whatever they wished.
